items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was one of a number of fine pianists that were in the Detroit area. Tommy Flanagan was from the Detroit area, Willie Anderson – –

ctx.x: Earl Van Riper? He’s a Detroit pianist. I meant Earl early on, and subsequently a couple times after. He passed away, I guess, about eight or 10 years ago, I believe. He was a fine pianist. He was one of a number of fine pianists that were in the Detroit area. Tommy Flanagan was from the Detroit area, Willie Anderson – –
I want to go through all these names and ask you about the relationships. Was – – is it Van Riper?
